scope: skill module engineering checks; [U] magnitudes are placeholders, see docs/PARAMETERS.md
checks: reads are pure and decay monotonically in [0, 1); practice raises the level; zero attention changes neither level nor stability; replaying the event log reproduces the stored state exactly; reads compose
with identical histories, more cognitive, more open-loop and more accuracy-graded skills retain less after the same idle time (E12 ordering, coefficients free)
spaced practice keeps more at a 60-day test than the same practice massed (0.015 vs 0.000); retrieval builds more stability than restudy (directions E8, E9)
relearning after near-total decay takes fewer practices than first learning (12 vs 16); a pruned skill keeps a savings record and relearns faster than a never-seen one (E13 direction)
near transfer only: a related skill speeds learning; below the similarity cutoff the boost is exactly zero
task-focused feedback gives at least the gain of none, self-focused at most (E21 direction)
perceived skill correlates r = 0.28 with true skill across a reference population (target .29, E22); no built-in overconfidence
the same seed and events give byte-identical states and logs; changing one seeding purpose changes only its own draws
no type, role, sex, occupation or name branch and no list of skills in the module; renaming people or adding identity facts changes nothing
a long idle stretch performs no skill computation; a stubbed run makes the same model calls with and without the module (14)
with gamma-distributed rates, 88% of individual curves fit an exponential better than a power function (AIC) while the population mean fits a power function better (E2 mechanism, not the science)
strategy shifts make visible dips in individual curves (352 across 200 learners) while the population mean stays smooth (largest second difference 0.010)
practice volume alone does not decide level: 152 pairs where the one who practised less is better (aptitude and per-skill draws matter, E25)
high sleep pressure lowers performance below stored skill, which does not change; rested performance equals it

the competence gate decides success outside the model (a novice fails a hard repair although the scenario said 100%), logs every check, and its directive describes not knowing without asking for wrong content
abandonment emerges: repeated failure lowers the learned value and wanting, and the softmax then picks that practice only 0% of the time (no abandonment hazard exists)
a sensitivity sweep reports outcome ranges across placeholder parameters (results/skills-sensitivity.json)
